title: The Show page's mission footer says when the mission last landed, not "no landing yet" for every mission that has not landed since midnight
prompt:
Read web/src/components/show/ShowView.tsx (the mission footer: `lastLanding`, `landedText`), web/src/show.ts (`landings`) and web/src/components/show/useShowFeed.ts (which events the scene loads), and `GET /api/rsi`'s missions (web/src/rsi.ts).

The problem. On the Show page (lead-mac, sync/page-show-2026-11-12-0012.png), the mission footer says "Spawn ... no landing yet" and "Supply PA ... no landing yet". Both missions have landed tasks: Supply PA last on 11-10 (T253), and Spawn many times. The footer reads a mission's last landing only from the events the scene has loaded, and those start at local midnight. So every mission that hasn't landed since midnight reads "no landing yet", every night and on every quiet day. The `/api/rsi` answer that the footer already polls holds every landing (`objectives[].landings[].at_ms`).

Required behaviour.
(a) web/src/show.ts exports `missionLastLanding(mission, seen, at)`, where `mission` is a mission of `/api/rsi`, `seen` is a Map of task id to landing time (as show.ts `landings` returns it) and `at` is the scene's time. It returns the latest landing of the mission at or before `at`: the latest of the mission's own landings in the answer and the scene's landings of the mission's tasks. It returns null when there is none, and another mission's task in `seen` doesn't count.
(b) The footer's "landed ... ago" reads it. "no landing yet" is said only of a mission that has never landed (as of the scene's time). In replay, `at` is the replay clock, so the footer agrees with the clock.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/072.sh. The history is seeded as the store holds it, and `spawn serve` answers `GET /api/rsi`. Backlog mission 1 has objective 1 landed (task 1) 30 h ago and objective 2 (task 2) 5 h ago, with task 3 in flight.
- (1) Under node, `missionLastLanding`:
  - gives task 2's landing with an empty `seen`;
  - gives a later landing of task 3 in `seen`, but not one of task 99;
  - gives task 1's landing at an `at` one hour before task 2's, and null one hour before task 1's;
  - gives null for a mission with no landings.
It fails with 1 on ecb177ab: show.ts has no `missionLastLanding`, and the footer reads only the scene's events.

The product reason. Show is the page the owner leaves open to see the fleet work. Its footer saying no mission has ever landed is false most of the day, and it undercuts the one place meant to show progress at a glance.
